create_PyanNet_nn_model: create a PyanNet_nn segmentation model with custom sincnet, lstm, and linear config
build_PyanNet_nn_classifier: build the PyanNet_nn classifier and activation layers after setting specifications
run_PyanNet_nn_forward: run the PyanNet_nn forward pass on waveform tensors to get classification scores
